answer: Random peer audit: each identity posts a 500-unit deposit into a lagoon. Every epoch the audit tide rolls in: the beacon picks 5% at random, and three peers mirror-check each one's claimed work against the public ledger. A failing fake loses deposit and seat; an auditor clearing a fake loses its own deposit too. One hundred fakes cost 50,000 units, most caught in 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit, and earns full rewards.
